In this video,I walk you through the concept of secret scopes in Databricks, why they are essential for securing credentials, and demonstrates a hands‑on process to create, manage, and use secrets in the Databricks free edition using both the UI and API.

• The purpose of secret scopes and when to use them in Databricks projects

• Steps to add, list, retrieve, and delete secrets securely
